original_query: select sum(l_extendedprice* (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from lineitem, part where ( p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#31' and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') and l_quantity >= 10 and l_quantity <= 10 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 5 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' ) or ( p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#22' and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') and l_quantity >= 19 and l_quantity <= 19 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 10 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' ) or ( p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#25' and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') and l_quantity >= 27 and l_quantity <= 27 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 15 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' );
rewritten_query:
SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN part AS p
  ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG')
  AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
  AND (
        (p.p_brand = 'Brand#31'
         AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
         AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5
         AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20)
     OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#22'
         AND p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
         AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10
         AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 19 AND 29)
     OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
         AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
         AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15
         AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 27 AND 37)
      );

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Convert the implicit comma join into an explicit INNER JOIN with a single join condition p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey. Since (J AND A) OR (J AND B) OR (J AND C) = J AND (A OR B OR C), factoring out the common join key produces an equivalent query with clearer join semantics.

Factor the predicates repeated in every OR branch (l_shipmode IN ('AIR','AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON') out of the OR expression, and fold constant arithmetic such as 10 + 10 into BETWEEN bounds (10-20, 19-29, 27-37). This reduces the predicate tree and improves readability without changing semantics.

The plan's dominant cost is the parallel sequential scan of lineitem (60M rows) plus a complex OR join filter. A UNION ALL split of the three brand branches can enable branch-specific index access, but risks three lineitem scans when no suitable index exists, so it is not chosen as the default rewrite. Supporting indexes (e.g., lineitem(l_partkey, l_shipmode, l_shipinstruct, l_quantity) INCLUDE (l_extendedprice, l_discount) and part(p_brand, p_container, p_size) INCLUDE (p_partkey)) would have the highest impact (score ~9/10).
